title: useMemo and useCallback

theory.english: useMemo and useCallback are performance optimization hooks. useMemo memoizes the result of an expensive computation — it only re-calculates when its dependencies change. useCallback memoizes a function reference — it returns the same function instance between renders unless dependencies change. This is important when passing callbacks to child components that are wrapped in React.memo, preventing unnecessary re-renders. Do not overuse these hooks — only apply them when you have measured an actual performance problem.
theory.hindi: useMemo aur useCallback performance optimization hooks hain. useMemo ek expensive computation ke result ko memoize karta hai — yeh tabhi recalculate karta hai jab dependencies change hoti hain. useCallback ek function reference ko memoize karta hai — yeh renders ke beech same function instance return karta hai jab tak dependencies change na hon. Yeh tab important hota hai jab aap callbacks React.memo se wrapped child components ko pass karte ho.
theory.hinglish: useMemo expensive calculations memoize karta hai — dependencies change hone par hi recalculate karta hai. useCallback function reference memoize karta hai — same function instance deta hai har render par. Dono performance optimization ke liye hain. Over-use mat karo — sirf actual performance problem par use karo.

examples.title: useMemo and useCallback
examples.explanation: Without useCallback, every name input keystroke would re-render ExpensiveChild because a new function is created each render. useCallback prevents this.

exercises.prompt: Create a component with a search input and a large list. Use useMemo to filter the list only when the search term changes, not on other state changes.
exercises.expectedOutcome: useMemo wrapping the filter logic with the search term as a dependency.

quiz.question: What does useMemo do?
options: Memoizes the result of a computation
quiz.explanation: useMemo caches and returns the result of an expensive computation, only recomputing when its dependencies change.

quiz.question: When should you use useCallback?
options: When passing a function to a memoized child component
quiz.explanation: useCallback is most useful when passing callbacks to child components wrapped in React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders.

quiz.question: What is the risk of overusing useMemo and useCallback?
options: Added complexity with no benefit for simple cases
quiz.explanation: These hooks add complexity and their own overhead. For simple cases, the optimization cost can exceed the benefit.

summary: useMemo aur useCallback chapter complete! Aapne seekha memoization kya hai, kab use karna chahiye, aur React.memo ke saath kaise use karte hain.
